node.statement: Idempotence with a common adjusted defect: after enlarging C_R>=1, node 1.1 makes R,P,Q all (C_R e)-projections. Put delta'=C_R e. Since delta'+epsilon<=(C_R+1)e, choosing e universally small permits application of lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities at n=1 to (R,Q) and (P,Q), and yields E^2=E and F^2=F.
